tools.list.api: Agent({ mcpServers }) tools in the ModelRequest

progress.api: MCPServerStdio({ toolMetaResolver: () => ({ progressToken }) }); no hook receives notifications/progress

logging.unsupported: MCPServer options take no message or logging handler; notifications/message reaches nothing

set_level.unsupported: MCPServer has no logging/setLevel method; the SDK Client.setLoggingLevel sits behind the protected session field

completion.unsupported: MCPServer has no completion method; the SDK Client.complete sits behind the protected session field

cancellation.mechanism: Runner.run(agent, input, { signal }) aborting the tool call
